property_summary: For every input with a non-empty _tos array, the reference C.transfer never returns false (it always returns true if it doesn't revert); the mutant can return false when any external low-level call to caddress fails, so the universal rule (always-true return) is broken by some inputs where the callee reverts/fails.
change_summary: Return false immediately if any call fails; previously always returned true regardless of call results.
